# Copilot Instructions

## General Guidelines
- Keep board cell size unchanged.
- Render Reversi discs as filled circles sized 75% of a cell (disc diameter = 75% of cell) on the green board.
- Black discs are filled black; white discs are filled white with a dark border.
- Show legal moves for the side to move as small hint dots.
- Ask for permission to save preferences only once; avoid repeating 'Memory detected' prompts.
